html:
{#-
  Barries Price Tag  ── 2.25" × 1" @ 203 DPI  (457 × 203 dots)
  Uline P/N S-18459
  ---------------------------------------------------------------
  Zone layout:
    y =  18 —  42  : title (brand + model + size, centered)
    y =  50 — 115  : Code 128 barcode (Subset C, centered, with digits below)
    y = 150 — 190  : MSRP price (right aligned, large)
  Fields pulled:
    doc.brand / doc.custom_model / doc.custom_size → title line
    doc.custom_upc_helper (fallback: doc.item_code) → barcode
    doc.standard_rate                              → MSRP price
-#}
^XA
^PW457
^LL203
^CI28
^FO10,18^A0N,24,24^FB437,1,0,C,0^FD{{ ((doc.brand or "") ~ " " ~ (doc.custom_model or "") ~ " " ~ (doc.custom_size or ""))[:30] }}^FS
{%- set barcode_data = doc.custom_upc_helper or doc.item_code -%}
{% if barcode_data %}
^BY2,2,55
^FO128,50^BCN,55,Y,N,N,A^FD{{ barcode_data }}^FS
{% endif %}
^FO170,150^A0N,40,40^FB270,1,0,R,0^FD${{ "{:.2f}".format(doc.standard_rate or 0) }}^FS
^XZ
